aiDisclosure.body: When you talk with a philosopher or answer a question during Measure, what you write is sent to a third-party AI provider to generate the reply or the reading. This happens every time, whether or not you have an account — see the privacy policy for details.

sources.title: Where this comes from
sources.disclaimer: Selfinder is a self-reflection practice, not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. The ideas here — including the map of seventeen states and the psychological concepts referenced on each level's page — are drawn from the named sources below. If you're struggling with your mental health, please talk to a doctor or a licensed mental health professional.

howToUse.title: How to use Selfinder
howToUse.intro: A few ways of touching the app that aren't always obvious at a glance.
howToUse.saveBody: Wherever you see a glowing image or figure — the aura on Depths, a Card, Feeling Lucky's message, the kaleidoscope on Your Arc — press and hold to save it to your own photo gallery.
howToUse.ringBody: On the Levels map, and wherever a reading's own wheel appears, drag your finger around the ring to feel your way through the states — it names whatever you're pointing at and settles on release.

guide.chooseSomeone: Choose who walks beside you in the You tab to begin.
guide.measureExplainer: A short conversation about your body, mind, heart, and spirit. At the end, {{name}} reflects the state emerging from your answers.

yourArc.tapPointHint: Tap a point to open that day again

yourArc.signInToSaveNote: Sign in and save your readings to keep the full story behind each point — what you said, what your philosopher reflected back.
yourArc.coneFramingLine: Here is where you are. Here is how you've told it. Here is what's calling you forward.
yourArc.coneFutureFraming: This moment already holds what you're reaching for — the way one note leans toward the next.

yourArc.closingSynthesisWithWish: {{level}} is still close. So is what you wished for. Both are here, in this moment, the way a held note is still sounding after the ones before it.
yourArc.closingSynthesisNoWish: {{level}} is still close, here in this moment, the way a held note is still sounding after the ones before it.
yourArc.closingNeedLine: Whatever moved through what you've read and wished for has its own reason — you already know it.
yourArc.closingWishInvite: Is there something you're reaching for?

yourArc.tryAsTrueExplain: An exercise, not a claim: write your wish again, as the feeling itself, present tense — not what you want, but what it would feel like if it were already so.

tuneIn.title: Tune your field with frequency
tuneIn.introLine: Two tones a few Hz apart, one per ear — your brain reads the gap as a single slow pulse. Needs stereo headphones.

yourArcPreview.title: The line you're already drawing
yourArcPreview.introLine: Every reading you take is a point. This is the real shape they trace so far.
yourArcPreview.fullLine: The full line, not just your last {{count}} readings — every walk you've ever taken, in order.
yourArcPreview.tapAnyPoint: Tap any point on it to open that day again: what it read as, and what your philosopher said about it.
yourArcPreview.keepConversationDescription: You've come back to this a few times — Selfinder+ keeps the whole conversation with {{name}} going, not just one reading at a time.
yourArcPreview.footnote: Everything you already have — Measure, Guide, Spill, Tune In, Breathing — stays free. This is about keeping the whole line, not a better version of the daily practice itself.
yourArcPreview.pointUnlockHint: Subscribe to Selfinder+ to see what you said and what your philosopher reflected back that day →

breathing.bodyFocusPrompt: Feel where {{level}} lives in your body right now. Rest your attention there for a moment, then breathe.
breathing.directionPrompt: What direction does it give you now? Where does it pull you?

measureIntro.title:
A conversation to read
where you are right now
measureIntro.copy: {{name}} will ask you about four sides of your life — body, mind, heart, and spirit. Share what is actually true, not what you think it should be. The reading emerges from what you say.

spill.title: Write without looking back
spill.copy1: For one minute, just keep writing. Whatever comes, in any order, without editing it — you'll only ever see the word you're writing right now, nothing before it. When the minute is up, you can read the whole thing back.
spill.copy2: There's no wrong way to do this. Typos, half-thoughts, and repeats are part of it.

spillReveal.kept: Kept — you can find it later from your account.
spillReveal.keepNeedsConsent: Turn on saving your data in account settings to keep entries like this

levels.title: The map of consciousness
levels.copy: Seventeen states, none of them better or worse than another — drag around the wheel to see where each one sits.
levels.note: These connections describe what's true between neighboring states, not a route everyone has to walk — you can move from Anger to Love and back to Reason without passing through everything between, and that's not doing it wrong.

crisisSupport.title: If it's more than a wish
crisisSupport.body: What you wrote sounds like it might be more than Selfinder can hold. There are people trained for this, ready right now — reaching out isn't a step down from anything.
crisisSupport.call988Sublabel: Suicide & Crisis Lifeline — free, 24/7, in the US
crisisSupport.findHelplineSublabel: findahelpline.com — a directory of local crisis lines
crisisSupport.footnote: You can come back to Selfinder whenever you're ready. Nothing here was saved.
